pages.text: The End Forge has 2 item slots and 1 fluid tank. It needs no entropy for the first recipe.

Endorium: 250 mB lava + 2 ender pearls + 4 end stone gives 1 endorium ingot (0 entropy, 10 s).$(br)Infused ingot: 250 mB Ichor + 1 endorium gives 1 infused ingot (40 entropy, 7.5 s).$(br)More endorium: 250 mB Ichor + 2 ender pearls + 4 end stone gives 4 endorium ingots (40 entropy, 7.5 s).$(br2)Look at the recipes in JEI.
